# Logistics 0.1.2 alpha 14

- Expand Books and Comics reading parity, automatic spreads, fold-aware layouts and native fullscreen magnification.
- Cache remote EPUB archives in memory, dismiss search keyboards on outside taps and keep folder pagination current.
- Consolidate rclone transfer review, retries, direct readers and multiple saved or session-only credential packages.
- Coalesce pending transfer progress to the latest snapshot, preserving terminal state and rejecting stale callbacks.
- Add Mac launchers for signed Android Firebase betas and sequential device/beta deployments, with explicit distribution prompts and protected local signing state.
- Keep native concurrency checks on real throttled transfers with independent route lifetimes and reviewed probe cleanup.
- Retain detailed native review status on timeout without changing confirmation decisions or the 15-minute gate.

The iOS TestFlight application version is 0.1.6. Publication requires all desktop platform, native mobile and mobile runtime checks to pass. This candidate includes the latest committed commonUtils and Logistics changes and supersedes the earlier unpublished candidates.
